why: Both analyses reach nearly the same hedgehog, stop-doing list and decline risks, but Analysis 1 makes off-platform leakage the single most urgent brutal fact, while Analysis 2 leads its verdict with the financing/runway issue and softens leakage to 'partly'. Analysis 1 is also better calibrated: it tags the 82% fill rate's underlying assumption once, whereas Analysis 2 states 82% untagged and cites bookings-per-machine as 'rising utilization'.
